description: Implementation of CategoryDao for database operations related to categories in an e-commerce system, using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation for Category entity, providing methods to retrieve categories based on various criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a name pattern within a specific store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories by their SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a single category by its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves multiple categories by their codes within a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their IDs within a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID and language.

methods.name: getByCode (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by their lineage within a store or by store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given parent category within a store.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store, optionally filtered by parent category.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with given categories within a store.

methods.name: listByStore (with language)
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.
